contests.title: Norwalk Community School District — Measure A: School improvement bonds

provenance.quote:
Shall the Board of Directors of the
Norwalk Community School District, in
Warren County, State of Iowa, be
authorized to contract indebtedness and
issue general obligation bonds in an
amount not exceeding $65,000,000 for
the purpose of acquiring, furnishing,
equipping, constructing, improving,
repairing, and renovating school
buildings and improving the sites of the
School District's school buildings and
athletic facilities located in Norwalk,
Iowa, including without limitation: (a) a
new elementary school building and
site/land improvements; (b) HVAC
system replacement and improvements,
kitchen ventilation system
improvements, and other mechanical or
electrical upgrades to Oviatt Elementary
School, Lakewood Elementary School,
and Secondary Campus; (c) building
improvements and upgrades to enhance
security at all existing school buildings,
including security systems and
enhanced building safety measures; (d)
a new transportation building, including
maintenance bays, a wash bay, a
custodial room, offices, common areas,
and site/land improvements; and (e)
improving athletic facilities and related
parking areas, including construction of
a new practice field and building
improvements and expansions for
additional practice areas, offices,
storage space, common areas, and
related site improvements?

contests.title: Interstate 35 Community School District — Measure Z: School improvement bonds

provenance.quote:
Shall the Board of Directors of the
Interstate 35 Community School District
in the Counties of Clarke, Madison, and
Warren, State of Iowa, be authorized to
contract indebtedness and issue
General Obligation Bonds in an amount
not to exceed $12,300,000 to provide
funds to remodel, repair, improve, and
equip the school building, including
reconfiguration of academic spaces,
HVAC, mechanical and exterior
improvements; to build, furnish, and
equip athletic facilities, including a new
stadium and track, parking, and site
improvements, and for related
improvements to repurpose the existing
track and field, bleachers, and press
box; and for site and access
improvements to the school campus?

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Authorizes up to $65 million in general-obligation bonds for a new elementary school, heating, cooling, kitchen ventilation and other building systems at existing schools, security improvements, a new transportation building, and athletic facilities, parking and site improvements.

Authorizes up to $12.3 million in general-obligation bonds for school renovations, including academic spaces, heating, cooling, mechanical and exterior improvements; a new stadium and track with parking and site work; reuse of the existing track and field, bleachers and press box; and campus site and access improvements.
